title: Retired King & Lethal Plague
flavor: The Wraith King Ostarion and his Scourge had dominated the afterlife for endless years, he always had a frenzy for his everlasting royalty. He believed himself to be immortal with his Frozen Throne uncollapsed. But it turned out to be ridiculous, anything will decay and any power will elapse. Finally the Wraith King disappeared from the Frozen Throne and his ungoverned undead army lost control, spreading plague everywhere…

entries.name: Dark Willow
entries.detail: Ability Reworked into Bramble Maze <Battle Cry Ability: Activates before the battle starts> Creates a bramble maze to isolate random enemies from battle, victims cannot attack or be attacked until the maze disappears. Duration: 6 secs Targets: 1/2/3

entries.name: Invoker
entries.detail: Tornado Hurricane Removed and replaced by Ice Wall <Active Ability: Activates on Full Mana> Invoker generates a wall of solid ice to freeze enemies in a line and impairs them from healing. Duration: 3/4/5 secs Radius: 200 Healing Reduction Percent: 50

entries.name: Chess pieces temporarily removed
entries.detail: Wraith King, Clinkz, Visage

entries.name: Snapfire - Lil Shredder
entries.detail: Base damage decreased from 100/150/200 to 75/100/150, but with an additional 25% attack damage of its owner.

entries.name: Templar Assassin - Refraction
entries.detail: Now becomes a damage taking Shield of 30/40/50 damage instead of a Block of damage, times decreased from 4/6/9 to 3/5/7

entries.name: Warlock - Chaotic Offering
entries.detail: Golems lasts 5-15 secs instead of 5-10 secs, and deathrattle of an extra Golem removed. Instead, the Warlock gains a chance to call upon an extra Golem himself.

entries.name: Sven - God's strength
entries.detail: Additional damage percent increased from 60%/120%/180% to 80%/160%/240%

entries.name: Undead - Plague
entries.detail: (3)(6)Max HP reduction increased from 10%/40% to 15%/45%, (9) Reworked into Plague-infected pieces will die immediately after a while. (3) Undead: All non-undead pieces of both sides in the battle gain the plague effect: maximum health -10%%. (6)Undead: All non-undead pieces of both sides in the battle gain the plague effect: maximum health -40%%. (9)Undead: Plague-infected pieces will die immediately after a while. P.S. Plague-infected pieces will last for random 15-20 secs

entries.name: Elf - Evasion
entries.detail: (9) Elves: All dodging will create a mirrored attack from the attacker, targeting the enemy. (3) Elves: All friendly elves have +25%% evasion. (6) Elves: All friendly elves have +45%% evasion. (9) Elves: friendly elves gain the effect: Dodging any attack creates a mirrored attack from the attacker, targeting the enemy. P.S.1. Mirrored chess pieces inherit passive effects from the carrier's equipment. P.S.2. Mirrored pieces last for 7 secs, and have an internal CD of 3 secs for the next mirrored piece.

entries.name: Draenei - Blessing of Naru
entries.detail: (4) Draeneis: CD increased from 2 secs to 3 secs and damage limit decreased from 400 to 300

entries.name: Shaman - Hex
entries.detail: Channeling time increased from 1 sec to 2.5 secs

entries.name: Druid Class Portrait
entries.detail: ★★ and ★★★ Druid Pieces will not rejoin the public chess pool when selled.

entries.name: Priest Class Portrait
entries.detail: Priest Pieces are determined, and cannot be mind controlled.

entries.name: Ascetics Cap
entries.detail: Multiple Caps not stackable

entries.name: Black King Bar
entries.detail: Duration decreased from 5 secs to 4 secs

entries.name: Aeon Disk
entries.detail: Carrier and its minions will be a permanent chess piece. <Active Ability: Activates when at low health.> Dispels all negative status from the caster and grants 100%% damage block for 3 seconds. P.S. Mirrored Chess pieces will not be regarded as permanent pieces.

entries.name: Monopoly Contract
entries.detail: Reworked You will get a prize when combining pieces ,★★ prize equals to (the cost of its base piece) and ★★★ prize equals to (the cost of its base piece * number of the chess piece owned by all players). Your ★★★ piece will immediately remove all pieces of the same name in the chess pool. P.S.1. ★★★ already owned and new combined have the same effects in Monopoly Contract P.S.2. Removed permanently, never back to the chess pool again.

entries.name: Chiaroscuro Certainty
entries.detail: Reworked +1 Award for win/lose streak, and a Spoil Token granted whose level equals to your original streak bonus when terminated. P.S.1. Spoil Token granted will never be any level higher than currently available Tokens. P.S.2. 2~4 Streak for Spoil Token Level 1, 5~9 Streak for Spoil Token Level 2, 10+ Streak for Spoil Token Level 3(Only after Round 25). P.S.3. Details are as follows： 1 Streak 2-4 Streak 5-9 Streak 10+ Streak No Relic 0 1 2 3 Prev Relic 0 2 4 6

entries.name: UI Adjustment
entries.detail: Win/Lose Streak will show up at the top right bar instead of interest

entries.name: General
entries.detail: Various bug fixes.
